environment.description: Node.js 20 Apollo Server 4.x deployed on a single EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. Sessions are stored in Redis with 24-hour TTL. CORS allows all origins with credentials. No CSRF token middleware. ALB forwards all POST requests to the origin without inspection. Cookie SameSite attribute is set to 'None' for cross-subdomain SSO compatibility.

config.alb_config: default listener rules, no WAF attached
